name: memU (sandbox)
postStartCommand: claude install latest 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -d /home/dev/.dotfiles-src ] && command -v chezmoi >/dev/null; then mkdir -p /tmp/cm/cache /tmp/cm/config && chezmoi apply --source /home/dev/.dotfiles-src --destination /home/dev --cache /tmp/cm/cache --config /tmp/cm/config/chezmoi.toml --no-tty --force --exclude scripts ~/.claude 2>/dev/null || true; fi; cp -f /home/dev/.claude-seed.json /home/dev/.claude.json 2>/dev/null || true; mkdir -p /home/dev/.azure && if [ -d /home/dev/.azure-host ]; then cp -f /home/dev/.azure-host/azureProfile.json /home/dev/.azure-host/clouds.config /home/dev/.azure-host/config /home/dev/.azure-host/az.json /home/dev/.azure-host/msal_token_cache.json /home/dev/.azure-host/service_principal_entries.json /home/dev/.azure 2>/dev/null || true; fi; mkdir -p /home/dev/.config-rw/gh /home/dev/.config-rw/gcloud; if [ -d /home/dev/.gh-host ]; then cp -f /home/dev/.gh-host/config.yml /home/dev/.gh-host/hosts.yml /home/dev/.config-rw/gh/ 2>/dev/null || true; chmod -R u+rwX /home/dev/.config-rw/gh; fi; if [ -d /home/dev/.gcloud-host ]; then for c in credentials.db access_tokens.db application_default_credentials.json active_config; do cp -f /home/dev/.gcloud-host/$c /home/dev/.config-rw/gcloud/ 2>/dev/null || true; done; for d in configurations legacy_credentials; do [ -d /home/dev/.gcloud-host/$d ] && cp -rf /home/dev/.gcloud-host/$d /home/dev/.config-rw/gcloud/ 2>/dev/null || true; done; chmod -R u+rwX /home/dev/.config-rw/gcloud; fi; container-mcp-register 2>/dev/null || true; claude-rekey-workspace 2>/dev/null || true; container-secrets-load 2>/dev/null || true; CONTAINER=1 python3 /home/dev/.dotfiles-src/run_onchange_after_settings-json.py 2>/dev/null || true; git config --global url."https://github.com/".insteadOf git@github.com: 2>/dev/null || true; git config --global credential."https://github.com".helper '!f() { [ "$1" = get ] && [ -n "$GH_TOKEN" ] && { echo username=x; echo password=$GH_TOKEN; }; }; f' 2>/dev/null || true; git config --global core.askPass "" 2>/dev/null || true
